title: Integrating Leader Humility and Integrity: Pathways to Enhanced Employee Pride and Helping Behavior
abstract: Abstract: Drawing on social exchange theory, this study examines how and when leader humility promotes employee helping behavior. Specifically, we propose that employee pride mediates this relationship and that leader integrity strengthens the positive effect of leader humility. To test our model, we conducted two studies. Study 1 employed a scenario-based experiment with 212 participants, revealing that the positive effect of leader humility on employee pride was stronger when leader integrity was high. Study 2 used a multisource, multiwave survey of 192 employees and their supervisors and replicated these findings. Furthermore, employee pride was positively related to helping behavior, and leader integrity strengthened the indirect effect of leader humility on helping behavior through employee pride. Theoretical and practical implications are discussed.
